sn22.82:14.16:
pajānātīti → “dve khandhā taññeva siyaṃ - adhivacanañca hetunā, 
sattā yena duve vuttā - assāda viññāṇakena ca, 
ete dasavidhā vuttā - hoti bhikkhu pucchāyātī”ti. 
dissateyaṃ gāthā machasaṃ, syā, PTS potthakesu.
